items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: We used to play for Litchens on Edward Street.

ctx.x: You mean you'd work on the docks in the daytime or play at night?

Yeah, play at night in the ballrooms and things, you know, we'd have... Most all the ballrooms had bands and things on Fridays and Saturdays and Sundays they'd have bands. But we'd team up and play there. We started playing with three pieces in some of them places. Then they'd have piano. We'd work out with the piano. Yeah, we'd have piano. Piano, drum, and trumpet. Papa Celeste used to work with me. We used to play for Litchens on Edward Street. For Litchens? Litchens. And Almarayston. Oh, Litchens didn't ever…
Almarayston, you're talking about that play? Sure. I used to play at the Plum Plan. Oh yeah? I played at the Plum Plan. Why did they call it the Plum Plan? I don't know.
